create_ProfilerData: create a ProfilerData instance to begin and finish timed profiling events by kind
build_ProfileReport: build a ProfileReport tree from a list of begin and finish Event objects
run_ProfilerData_begin_finish: run profiling by calling begin and finish on ProfilerData to track nested event timing
summarize_ProfileReport: summarize a ProfileReport to print a hierarchical breakdown of calls and time per kind
test_ProfilerData_time_in: test the ProfilerData time_in method to compute total time spent in a specific event kind
